name: sugarcraft/candy-git-server
description: Self-hostable Git server: smart-HTTP clone, fetch and push with Git LFS, behind fail-closed access gates. PHP port of the charmbracelet/soft-serve Go project; the git-daemon, SSH dispatcher and stats faces ship as classes, with serve --http the assembled listener (README Known gaps).

suggest.ext-pcntl: Graceful shutdown of the serve --http listener: SIGINT/SIGTERM handlers need pcntl, and a supervisor's stop signal on a pcntl-less host lands as the default-termination 130/143 exit instead of the documented clean stop. Minimal container images (php:8.3-cli) do not ship pcntl or sockets.
suggest.ext-ssh2: Lets User::generateKeyPair mint account keypairs in-process; without it, key generation needs ssh-keygen on PATH. It plays no part in authentication — the SSH dispatcher answers AccessControl and stored keys alone (finding 099).
